Added two types of snow
Audio snow reacts to system sounds

Still working on larger updates and porting to other systems. Merry Christmas everyone!

notes.title: Added second black screen mode, probably will work better on some devices
notes.content: If you have black screen issue and first black screen fix not works well, second black screen fix mode probably will help you. As always i highly recommend update your gpu drivers (discrete and integrated) and try in all modes if you get some unexpected black screens or lags/visual bugs.

Although they liked the safe transit through the desktops, they found a shorter route to their goal.
And some important notice. Cause modifier fix from yesterday some pets might be broken, automatic recovery not works for all, so most easy way to fix is recreate some not appearing pets from templates.
